title: Tunisian Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: A flavorful and healthy dish with a mix of Tunisian spices and aromatic flavors.
instructions: 2. Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
3. In a large skillet, stir-fry the fry until browned.
4. Add the rice, aromatic spices, and Tunisian spices to the skillet, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
5. Stuff each bell pepper with the rice mixture and top with a little water.
6. Place the bell peppers in a baking dish and cover with foil.
7. Bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
8. Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
